## Overview

This 2026-09-15-captured Issuing-path navigation page points from post-card-payment activity to Adyen's Platform Experience **Transactions** component. It says users can view transactional data, with a linked child guide for filtering/export and detail views. The page does not specify component setup, role checks, report grain or a verified transaction/export result. [[adyen]] [[adyen-issuing]]

## Key takeaways

- The page frames the component as an after-payment view for users who have made payments with the platform's cards (raw lines 15–19).
- Its **Transactions** child link advertises filtering and export by account or date, plus detailed fees, IDs and refunds (raw lines 21–25). These are listed UI functions; follow the child guide for implementation conditions and field behavior.

## Detail locators

- Page purpose and after-payment user context: raw lines 15–19. Transactions child route and summarized functions: raw lines 21–25. Component-library navigation: raw lines 27–29.
